hook.evidence: Introduces HMIMO as next-generation holographic communications beyond conventional MIMO/RIS.

gap.evidence: Notes lack of comprehensive coverage from applications to theory, enabling technologies, and challenges for HMIMO.

yes_but.evidence: Acknowledges existing works on RIS/large MIMO but highlights missing holistic HMIMO treatment.

contribution.evidence: Lists contributions covering applications, physical aspects, theory, enabling technologies, comparisons, and challenges.

organization.evidence: Provides organization roadmap in the introduction.

scope_boundary.evidence: Scope spans HMIMO applications, surfaces, theory, enabling technologies, comparisons, and challenges.

rhetorical_moves_global.reader_contract_pattern: Motivate HMIMO; define evolution and vision; present applications/enablers; detail physical surfaces; build theory; cover enabling signal processing; compare to related tech; list challenges; conclude.

taxonomy.classification_strategy: by aspect (applications, physical surfaces, theory, enabling processing)

visuals_tables.layout_logic: Heavy use of figures for surface structures, theory illustrations, and comparisons; tables summarize prototypes and comparisons; glossary precedes body.

figures.purpose: depict HMIMO surface structures and system concepts

tables.purpose: summarize trust? prototypes/comparisons of HMIMO surfaces (application/enabler summaries)

lesson_blocks.lesson: Application vision sets requirements that drive enabler selection.
Design/tuning/fabrication/aperture choices shape feasible HMIMO functionalities and prototypes.
EM-aligned channel/performance models and sampling/info theory ground HMIMO analysis.
Channel estimation and beamforming bridge theory to implementation.
Comparisons and open problems highlight where HMIMO surpasses or needs advances over RIS/large MIMO.

synthesis.aha_moment: Sequencing from vision and applications through physical surfaces, theory, enabling processing, and comparisons keeps HMIMO's complexity navigable and ties design choices back to requirements.

style.section_openers_pattern: Introduce aspect (applications/physical/theory/technology), then enumerate subelements with heavy use of figures and lists.

reusable_writing_recipes.title: Intro with evolution + contributions + organization
steps: Define the technology and its evolution from prior paradigms.
Provide a literature overview and explicit gap.
reusable_writing_recipes.why_it_works: Establishes novelty and navigation for a broad, multi-aspect survey.

reusable_writing_recipes.title: Physical-to-theory layering
steps: Detail physical aspects (hardware, design, tuning, fabrication, apertures, functions, prototypes).
Move to theoretical foundations (channel, performance, EM sampling/info theory).
reusable_writing_recipes.why_it_works: Layered flow mirrors how HMIMO moves from vision to implementable systems.

reusable_writing_recipes.title: Comparison-before-challenges pattern
steps: Compare the technology to related approaches to set baselines.
Follow with research challenges grouped by physical, theoretical, and processing axes.
reusable_writing_recipes.why_it_works: Grounds the open problems in clear contrasts with existing technologies.
